accepted_gaps.title: Sparse remote spectra lack a shared contextual evidence protocol
accepted_gaps.test: Compare context ledger and single-feature rules using declared biological and abiotic synthetic cases.
accepted_gaps.falsification: If the ledger does not improve calibration or reduce false-positive confidence, it has no demonstrated value.

accepted_gaps.title: Negative results lack sensitivity and completeness semantics
accepted_gaps.test: Require target class, recovery curve, band, and coverage before a negative label is released.
accepted_gaps.falsification: If sensitivity cards never change a negative-result interpretation, the contract is unnecessary.

accepted_gaps.title: Evidence modes lack a common provenance-aware falsification ledger
accepted_gaps.test: Audit whether shared evidence records reduce untracked abiotic, artifact, and contamination explanations.
accepted_gaps.falsification: If independent review finds equal omission rates without the ledger, the unified design is not justified.

accepted_gaps.title: Habitability ranking is conflated with occupancy inference
accepted_gaps.test: Report target priority and life-evidence status in separate fields.
accepted_gaps.falsification: If the two fields remain mathematically identical under all registered cases, separation adds no value.

accepted_gaps.title: Follow-up observations are not optimized for discriminating hypotheses
accepted_gaps.test: Pre-register expected discrimination value for each available follow-up.
accepted_gaps.falsification: If value-guided follow-up performs no better than fixed or random follow-up at equal budget, the strategy fails.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Use detection of oxygen alone as proof of extraterrestrial life.
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected because credible abiotic oxygen pathways and false-negative histories require environmental context.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Use a radio non-detection to conclude there are no technological civilizations.
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected because the result is band, sensitivity, recovery, duty-cycle, and population dependent.
